finalMessage:
Done. **NEO System** is built, tested, and shipped to `dist/`.

## What was built

**Base (all required criteria):**
- **3D solar system from real orbital elements** — Sun, 8 planets (orbit lines + labels), and all 42,075 NEOs, positioned by solving Kepler's equation from each body's own epoch. Validated numerically (planets within [q, Q] at J2000; Halley at perihelion = 0.577 au vs. catalog 0.575) and against JPL Horizons.
- **Interactive time** — play/pause (space), reverse, 1 hour/s → 1 year/s, date jump, "Now", arrow-key stepping; everything moves along its orbit.
- **Real data, fast** — a build step compacts the 15 MB asteroid JSON into a 2 MB binary; the vertex shader propagates all 42k orbits on the GPU, holding **60 fps** while time runs.
- **Usable, intentional design** — orbit/zoom camera, scale rings, exaggerated-but-adjustable body sizes, color legend, dark HUD aesthetic, loading screen.

**Open-ended directions (all implemented):**
- **Filter & search** — orbit class, PHA-only, Sentry-only, min diameter; instant search across asteroids/comets/planets.
- **Detail view** — orbit + physical data, close-approach history with click-to-jump dates, Sentry risk section (probability, Palermo/Torino, impact window).
- **Highlight what matters** — PHAs red in class mode; a dedicated Risk color mode; an "Upcoming close approaches" panel synced to simulation time.
- **Comets** — ~4,000, including correct hyperbolic (from `tp`, hyperbolic Kepler) and parabolic (Barker's equation) propagation.
- **Focus & follow** — camera flies to selections and can lock on while time runs.
- **Deep links** — time, camera, selection, follow, mode, filters all encoded in the URL hash, applied live on `hashchange` (e.g. `#t=2462240.4&sel=a:99942&fol=1`).

Everything verified end-to-end with headless-Chrome smoke tests (`scripts/smoke*.mjs`): zero console errors, filter counts exact, deep-link restore working, Apophis/Bennu/Halley/Encke detail views confirmed. `data/` untouched, no external calls, relative URLs throughout, and a clean-slate `pnpm install && pnpm build` succeeds.
